findings.text: blocking: _name_context supplies no 'items' or 'ids_contexts', which both composition templates iterate, so name_composition and name_review render identical prompts for different names: 1 distinct digest across all 251 census rows.
non-blocking: content_from_prompt_context fills source_text from dd_description or description, so a description-only item reports source_text present though the prompt carried no source text.
non-blocking: provenance model_calls and graph_writes are hardcoded zero rather than measured, so the page's zero-spend claim cannot fail.
non-blocking: the docstring still describes a two-panel figure while draw() emits one 7x11 matrix, and the names parameter is unused.
non-blocking: _CHILDREN_QUERY duplicates the children loader at worker_review_docs.py:174, so one channel has two statements.
non-blocking: no test requires two distinct names to produce distinct prompt digests, so the composition collapse stays green.
non-blocking: the page quotes 8909 passed at c5f432f12 but no such log remains; gate.log holds a 22-passed focused run, so that suite evidence cannot be re-read.

item_verdicts.call_sites: Verified all eight call sites; each calls record_stage_receipt immediately before building the model messages with the same context the prompt renders from.
item_verdicts.diff: Read the range c7ae574a..38161f4eb: 18 files, 30381 insertions; adds context_receipt.py, children and producer channels, eight call sites, the census, the evidence page, the figure and three tests; no prompt template text changed.
item_verdicts.done_when: Census, ranked omissions, 33-member cross-tabulation, both controls, children and producer channels and zero metered spend are present; the 'census renders each stage's prompt' clause is false for two of seven stages.
item_verdicts.goal: All eight stages call record_stage_receipt and omissions are counted, but the census renders name_composition and name_review without their per-name block, so for those stages it measures the case file rather than the prompt the stage is shown.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records the repair round and per-finding controls, but has no baseline_suite or after_suite field, so added failures were read from gate-first-pass.log (1 failed, 8908 passed at 434b471c5) and the head run of that test (1 passed).
item_verdicts.write_paths: The declared paths are the evidence page, the figure directory and context_receipt.py; the diff also touches case_file.py, eight worker_tasks files, three tests and the census script, all implied by the done_when, so the extras are in expected scope though undeclared.

justifications.durability: Positive, negative and default-sink tests exist, but none requires distinct names to yield distinct prompts, so the composition collapse passes the suite.
justifications.evidence: 251 names, 12 omissions, both controls and the cross-tabulation are recorded, but the composition digest is identical across all 251 rows and the zero-spend figures are constants.
justifications.fit: _stage_context delegates to build_compose_context and the channel vocabulary to the case file, but _CHILDREN_QUERY duplicates the loader in worker_review_docs.py.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The live half runs and every stage records a receipt, but two of seven stages are measured from the case file because their rendered prompt carries no per-name block.
justifications.reuse: The section half and channel vocabulary are owned elsewhere, but the children query is re-implemented and prompt row shapes are partly re-derived.
justifications.scope_discipline: The diff stays inside the section and the artefacts the done_when names; the undeclared case_file.py and worker_tasks paths follow directly from its clauses.
